# Milo

> Milo is a free website where adults aged 18 and over meet people who share their hobbies. Members choose Friends mode, Dating mode or both, send requests, and chat once a request is accepted. Milo is operated by Shiva Tiwari in Ayodhya, India.

Milo is for adults 18+ only. It has no paid plans and no voice or video calls.

## Pages
- [Home](https://milosathi.netlify.app/): what Milo is, how it works, safety tips, FAQ and what is live
- [Privacy, Terms and Cookies](https://milosathi.netlify.app/legal.html): privacy policy, terms and conditions, cookies policy

## What works today
- Sign up and log in (18+ age check at signup)
- Profile with hobbies, vibe, username and mode (Friends, Dating or Both)
- Suggestions of people who share hobbies, same city first, plus search by name or username
- Friend requests, live chat after a request is accepted, block and report
- Invite link, feedback form, delete-my-account option
- Help chatbot and two simple scripted chat bots (Aarav and Anaya), clearly labelled as bots

## What is not available
- Voice or video calls
- Paid plans or memberships
- Google, Facebook or phone-number login (not yet built)

## Privacy in short
- Other members see only name, username, city, hobbies and vibe. Email, date of birth and gender are never shown.
- Accounts and all related data can be deleted from My profile.
